verdicts.reason: The two candidates are effectively the same layout. The only visible difference is that B's SOLSTICE logo is a few pixels narrower. Both have the same flaws: the purple circle is now fully on the canvas and sits right under the quote text instead of bleeding off the left edge as in the original. There is a large empty band above the quote mark. The product can stays small and pushed right inside an oversized maroon circle, leaving the lower-left nearly empty apart from the tiny logo.
